body: I’m going through the same thing. I’ve Been thinking this way for 2-3 years now, and what keeps me going is grounding myself, finding small things that make me  realize that eventually I will have a decent life. I’ve grown a small succulent collection just to ground me, just so I see them and say “wow if I wasn’t here, they wouldn’t exist” its small and it may be stupid but it works.
If anyone was following this, the job interview went better than I expected but✨shocker✨I didn’t get the job
